key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9394
name: cycle_detail_level_text
description: Decrements the detail-level character in the text buffer, wrapping from the slash back to the digit two and resetting the associated counter on wrap. It then calls the shared routine and prints the centred status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9406
name: step_engine_sound_phases
description: Advances a five-step counter; steps two to four switch the sound-effect flags and call the sound driver hooks, while the final step resets the counter. The routine then prints the centred status line, whose text refers to engine sound being off.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:944E
name: enable_sound_effects_state
description: Calls the sound driver start hook, clears the sequence counter and the two sound-channel flags, and sets the sound-effects flag. It then prints the centred status line reading that sound effects are on.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:947C
name: silence_all_sound_channels
description: Sets the sound-control byte to all ones, invokes the driver silence hook, and prints the centred status line reading that all sound is off.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9492
name: select_music_track_one
description: Sets the music flags for the first track, calls the sound driver music hook, and prints the centred Music 1 label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:94B4
name: select_music_track_two
description: Sets the music flags for the second track, calls the sound driver music hook, and prints the centred Music 2 label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9518
name: relay_driver_call_registers
description: Calls a sound-driver entry through a pointer held in the data area and returns the two saved data-register values unchanged. It is a pass-through wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:952A
name: pass_through_shared_call
description: Calls the shared routine and returns the incoming data-register values unchanged. The body contains no logic beyond that call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:953C
name: swap_slot_wait_and_restore
description: Saves the first long word of an object record, swaps it with the following word, and calls a driver hook. It then polls a status byte until it clears, writes a fill value, and restores the saved word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:959A
name: dispatch_object_handler
description: Clears the object's per-frame flag and jumps through the handler pointer stored in the object record. The jump table could not be recovered, so the target is only known at run time.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:95A4
name: cycle_control_sensitivity_level
description: Advances a two-bit sensitivity index, skipping zero, stores it as a digit character, and prints the sensitivity label. The label reads control sensitivity two.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:95F0
name: cycle_indexed_table_value
description: Advances a two-bit index in the object record, copies the matching entry from a four-value table into the location the record points to, and prints the status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:95F2
name: cycle_control_method_setting
description: Advances a two-bit index in the object record, copies the matching entry from a four-value table into the destination the record points to, and prints the control-method status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9686
name: compute_angle_table_index
description: Reduces an angle-like input to a 45-step index using a 360-unit cycle, then looks up table values for the object's coordinates. The results are written into word variables used for drawing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:96BA
name: restore_saved_plane_block_masked
description: Restores a block of nine saved long words from RAM, then while a frame counter is positive, decrements it and ORs a mask word into three spaced rows of the playfield buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:96F0
name: draw_masked_rows_with_restore
description: Restores nine saved long words from RAM, then ORs a mask word into three spaced playfield rows while a frame counter remains positive. It then continues with further row writes through the routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9798
name: draw_masked_rows_second_block
description: Restores nine saved long words from RAM and ORs a mask word into three spaced playfield rows while a frame counter is positive. The routine differs from its neighbours only in the rows it writes afterwards.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9834
name: select_source_then_mask_rows
description: Chooses between two source pointers based on their sign, calls the matching routines, and then ORs the mask word into three spaced playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9862
name: plot_branch_then_mask_rows
description: Branches on the sign of a source value, makes a series of routine calls for either branch, and then ORs a mask into the playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:999E
name: load_source_position_record
description: Loads a position from a source record (two long words and one word) or, when the record pointer is absent, from a second pointer, then calls the routines and writes the masked playfield rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:99F0
name: set_position_from_source_coords
description: Scales two source coordinates by 32 and stores them as position values, then runs the routines and ORs the mask into the playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9B3E
name: mask_playfield_rows_plain
description: ORs a mask word into three spaced playfield rows while a frame counter is positive, after a short sequence of routine calls and a block restore of nine saved long words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9B6E
name: enter_mask_rows_alternate_one
description: Alternate entry into the shared masked-row routine at an offset inside its body. It runs the same routine calls and row mask update, and it is reached through a stored address rather than a direct call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9B72
name: enter_mask_rows_alternate_two
description: Alternate entry into the shared masked-row routine at a second offset. It performs the same restore and mask update as its neighbours and is reached through a stored address.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9B76
name: enter_mask_rows_alternate_three
description: Alternate entry into the shared masked-row routine at a third offset, running the same routine calls and row mask update as the other entry points.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9BB2
name: start_blitter_copy_job
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its modulo, source-pointer and size registers for a copy, and starts it. The status register is read through the DMA control read.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9C60
name: mask_rows_after_position_check
description: Checks the source position, then ORs a mask word into three spaced playfield rows while a frame counter is positive, after restoring a saved block of nine long words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9C9C
name: select_path_then_mask_rows
description: Branches on a flag to choose one of two sets of five routine calls, then ORs a mask into the playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9D52
name: mask_rows_with_counter_check
description: Makes a series of routine calls, restores nine saved long words, and ORs a mask word into three spaced playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9D9C
name: run_title_countdown_and_show
description: Counts down a delay, and when it expires clears a set of display bytes, sets the DMA control word, and prints the F15 Strike Eagle title text. Otherwise it returns after running the routine calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9DF2
name: copy_record_name_into_buffer
description: Looks up a 50-byte record by index. When its flag is set, it copies the null-terminated string from the record into a 64-byte buffer; otherwise it clears the pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9E3A
name: find_flagged_record_copy_name
description: Searches up to ten 86-byte records for one with bit two set in its flag byte, then copies the null-terminated string from that record into a buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9E42
name: copy_patrol_status_label
description: Finds a flagged 86-byte record and copies a null-terminated string from it into the outgoing text buffer. Its referenced text is the status label ending in on patrol.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9EB4
name: init_dma_and_angle_state
description: Clears sprite-related state and writes the DMA control register with the enable bit set so the chosen channels start. It also computes an angle-table index used for drawing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:9F5A
name: update_display_state_mask
description: Handles a pending display-state change and, depending on a counter, either runs the sprite update or the masked-row path through the routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A04E
name: refresh_display_state_a
description: Resets the pending display-state values, runs the sprite and routine calls, and then ORs a mask into the playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A100
name: refresh_display_state_b
description: Runs a longer sequence of routine calls for the pending display-state change, then ORs a mask into the playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_work_vars_then_mask
description: Copies three pairs of work values into their working variables, makes the routine calls, and then ORs a mask into the playfield rows while a frame counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_work_vars_alternate_entry
description: Alternate entry into the work-variable copy routine at a later offset. It performs the same three value copies and the masked-row update.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A2B6
name: build_sprite_control_words
description: Computes a horizontal sprite offset by dividing a value by five and scaling it by eight, writes the sprite control words into the sprite buffer, and updates the sprite pointer registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A3A2
name: build_second_sprite_control_pair
description: Computes a sprite offset from a value divided by ten, writes the sprite control words for the second pair, and updates the sprite pointer registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_sprite_pointer_slots
description: Writes zero into two pointer-target long words in the sprite record, clearing the two sprite pointer slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_sprite_slots_if_enabled
description: When a flag is set, copies two long words from the sprite record into the destination record. When the flag is clear it leaves the destination untouched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A492
name: store_passed_word_value
description: Calls two routines and stores the word passed in the data register into a global variable.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A4CA
name: load_sprite_pointers_block_a
description: Copies six long words from the object record into the global sprite pointer slots, followed by a final copy of the frame pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A50C
name: load_sprite_pointers_block_b
description: Copies five long words from the object record into the sprite pointer slots, then copies the frame pointer value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A54E
name: build_sprite_control_words_gated
description: Writes the sprite control words for the current frame when a state value is zero, updating the sprite pointer registers, then calls the routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A55A
name: load_sprite_pointers_block_c
description: Copies one long word from the object record and then repeats the pointer copy for the remaining sprite slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A58C
name: load_sprite_pointers_block_d
description: Copies four long words from the object record into the sprite pointer slots, then copies the frame pointer value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A606
name: update_active_object_slots
description: Loops over the object slots, calling routines for each active entry, and computes each slot's screen position from its coordinates. It also checks a status string reference, HCHDHE6, that is used as a label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A870
name: advance_palette_fade_counter
description: Decrements the fade counter. While it remains nonzero it calls the palette routines and keeps the fade running; once it reaches zero it loads the saved colour set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A878
name: step_palette_fade_background
description: Steps the palette fade and writes the background colour register. Once the fade counter expires, it loads the target colour set from the data area.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A912
name: check_object_inside_clip_box
description: Compares three coordinate deltas against fixed bounds and returns whether the object lies inside the clip box, then calls the routines for the object's shape.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:A94A
name: test_collision_bounding_ranges
description: Tests an object's position against range limits in two axes and a height bound, calling routines to get the values. On a hit it runs the collision response calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:AB20
name: reset_score_and_state_vars
description: Clears a block of state variables, sets the score digit strings to zero characters and the timer default to 10000, and sets extra defaults when a flag bit is present.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:AC72
name: update_flight_control_surfaces
description: Derives two control values from the stick inputs by offsetting, taking magnitude and scaling, then stores them. It also prints the status text for brakes on or landing gear raised.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:BDCE
name: detect_control_setting_changes
description: Compares two two-bit control fields with their stored values, updates the stored values, and sets a redraw flag when either changed.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:BEBE
name: interpolate_table_value_clamped
description: Looks up two neighbouring entries of a table from a computed index, interpolates between them with a fractional weight, and stores the clamped result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:BEC2
name: interpolate_table_value_entry
description: Alternate entry into the table interpolation routine. It computes the same index, interpolates between neighbouring table entries, and stores the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_two_axis_table
description: Performs table interpolation for two axes: it reads three table values, blends them linearly with fractional weights, and stores the combined result for the object.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:C1B8
name: interpolate_table_pair_unit_a
description: Blends two neighbouring entries of a table by a fractional weight taken from the low bits of a scaled angle, storing one interpolated coordinate. Sibling routines perform the same blend for other coordinates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:C1CC
name: interpolate_table_pair_unit_b
description: Blends two neighbouring table entries by a fractional weight from the low bits of a scaled angle and stores one interpolated coordinate. It matches its neighbours apart from the coordinate it writes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:C1E0
name: interpolate_table_pair_unit_c
description: Blends two neighbouring table entries by a fractional weight from the low bits of a scaled angle and stores one interpolated coordinate for the object.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:C1E8
name: interpolate_table_pair_unit_d
description: Blends two neighbouring table entries by a fractional weight from the low bits of a scaled angle and stores one interpolated coordinate.
